title: Markets, profit and acquisitions
focus: 股票 · 上市 · 收购 · 竞争对手 · 营收 · 盈利 · 亏损 · 裁员
body:
How a company does and how it ends up: revenue, profit and loss, competitors, layoffs, going public or getting bought. Sentences recycle the startup words from L25.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 股票 | gǔpiào | stock | share slip |
| 上市 | shàngshì | to go public / launch | go onto the market |
| 收购 | shōugòu | to acquire | take in by buying |
| 竞争对手 | jìngzhēng duìshǒu | competitor | the player opposite you |
| 营收 | yíngshōu | revenue | operating income |
| 盈利 | yínglì | to be profitable | overflowing profit |
| 亏损 | kuīsǔn | loss | come up short |
| 裁员 | cáiyuán | to lay off | cut staff |

## Which word?

**盈利 vs 亏损:** a mirror pair. 盈 is full or overflowing and 亏 is short or lacking; together they make 盈亏, profit and loss.

**营收 vs 收入 (L9):** 营收 is a company's revenue from operations. 收入 is anyone's income, including your own pay.

**收购 vs 并购:** 收购 is one company buying another. 并购 (merge-buy) is the general M&A term you hear in finance news.

## Sentences

- 他把存款都拿去买股票了，我妈很担心。 tā bǎ cúnkuǎn dōu ná qù mǎi gǔpiào le, wǒ mā hěn dānxīn.: He put all his savings into stocks, and my mum is worried.
- 公司上市以后，创始人的股份很值钱。 gōngsī shàngshì yǐhòu, chuàngshǐrén de gǔfèn hěn zhíqián.: After the IPO, the founders' shares are worth a fortune.
- 我们被竞争对手收购了，说实话有点尴尬。 wǒmen bèi jìngzhēng duìshǒu shōugòu le, shuō shíhuà yǒudiǎn gāngà.: We got acquired by our competitor. Honestly, a bit awkward.
- 营收涨得很快，但是还没盈利。 yíngshōu zhǎng de hěn kuài, dànshì hái méi yínglì.: Revenue is growing fast, but they're still not profitable.
- 去年亏损太严重，只好裁员。 qùnián kuīsǔn tài yánzhòng, zhǐhǎo cáiyuán.: Last year's losses were so bad that they had to do layoffs.
- 公司一裁员，大家都很焦虑。 gōngsī yì cáiyuán, dàjiā dōu hěn jiāolǜ.: As soon as layoffs start, everyone gets anxious.
- 收购的消息一出来，股票涨了百分之二十。 shōugòu de xiāoxi yì chūlái, gǔpiào zhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī èrshí.: When the acquisition news came out, the stock rose twenty percent.
- 不能一直烧钱，毕竟总要盈利。 bù néng yìzhí shāoqián, bìjìng zǒng yào yínglì.: You can't burn cash forever; after all, you have to turn a profit eventually.

cards.English: stock / shares (traded on the stock market)
cards.Example: 他每天都在看股票。 tā měitiān dōu zài kàn gǔpiào: He checks his stocks every day
cards.Notes: 股 gǔ share (股份 L25) + 票 piào ticket, slip (车票, 投票) = share slip, so stock. 股市 = stock market. 炒股 (stir-fry stocks) = trade stocks.

cards.English: to go public / IPO; (of a product) to launch
cards.Example: 公司明年准备上市。 gōngsī míngnián zhǔnbèi shàngshì: The company plans to go public next year
cards.Notes: 上 shàng go onto + 市 shì market (市场, 超市) = go onto the market. For a company it means an IPO; for a product, a launch (新手机下个月上市). 上市公司 = listed company.

cards.Example: 他们被一家大公司收购了。 tāmen bèi yì jiā dà gōngsī shōugòu le: They were acquired by a big company
cards.Notes: 收 shōu take in (收入 L9) + 购 gòu purchase, 贝 money (购物, 采购) = take in by buying, so acquire. 被收购 = get acquired. 并购 = M&A.

cards.Example: 我们的竞争对手降价了。 wǒmen de jìngzhēng duìshǒu jiàngjià le: Our competitor cut prices
cards.Notes: 竞 jìng contend (竞赛) + 争 zhēng fight for (争论 L17) = compete; 对 duì facing + 手 shǒu hand, player (选手, 高手) = the player opposite you. So 'competing opponent', a competitor. In speech, 对手 alone is enough.

cards.Example: 今年营收增长了一倍。 jīnnián yíngshōu zēngzhǎng le yí bèi: Revenue doubled this year
cards.Notes: 营 yíng operate, run (经营, 营业) + 收 shōu income (收入 L9) = operating income, so revenue. Short for 营业收入. 收入 is personal income; 营收 is a company's.

cards.English: to turn a profit / be profitable
cards.Example: 公司终于开始盈利了。 gōngsī zhōngyú kāishǐ yínglì le: The company finally turned a profit
cards.Notes: 盈 yíng full, overflowing + 利 lì profit (利息 L20, 利润) = surplus profit, so to be profitable. Mirror: 亏损 = loss. 盈亏 = profit and loss.

cards.English: (financial) loss / to run at a loss
cards.Example: 去年公司亏损了两千万。 qùnián gōngsī kuīsǔn le liǎngqiān wàn: The company lost twenty million last year
cards.Notes: 亏 kuī lack, come up short (吃亏) + 损 sǔn damage, lose (损失) = come up short and lose, so a loss. Mirror of 盈利. Spoken: 亏钱, 亏了 = lost money.

cards.Example: 公司下个月要裁员。 gōngsī xià gè yuè yào cáiyuán: The company is doing layoffs next month
cards.Notes: 裁 cái cut, as cloth (裁缝 tailor, 裁判 referee) + 员 yuán staff (员工, 职员) = cut staff, so lay off. 被裁 = get laid off. Compare 失业 (L22) = be unemployed.

cards.English: He put all his savings into stocks, and my mum is worried.
cards.Hanzi: 他把存款都拿去买股票了，我妈很担心。
cards.Pinyin: tā bǎ cúnkuǎn dōu ná qù mǎi gǔpiào le, wǒ mā hěn dānxīn.

cards.English: After the IPO, the founders' shares are worth a fortune.
cards.Hanzi: 公司上市以后，创始人的股份很值钱。
cards.Pinyin: gōngsī shàngshì yǐhòu, chuàngshǐrén de gǔfèn hěn zhíqián.
cards.Notes: 上市 (L26) + 创始人 + 股份 (L25).

cards.English: We got acquired by our competitor. Honestly, a bit awkward.
cards.Hanzi: 我们被竞争对手收购了，说实话有点尴尬。
cards.Pinyin: wǒmen bèi jìngzhēng duìshǒu shōugòu le, shuō shíhuà yǒudiǎn gāngà.
cards.Notes: 收购 + 竞争对手 (L26) + 说实话 (L1) + 尴尬 (L7).

cards.English: Revenue is growing fast, but they're still not profitable.
cards.Hanzi: 营收涨得很快，但是还没盈利。
cards.Pinyin: yíngshōu zhǎng de hěn kuài, dànshì hái méi yínglì.
cards.Notes: 营收 + 盈利 (L26). 涨 as in 涨价 (L9).

cards.English: Last year's losses were so bad that they had to do layoffs.
cards.Hanzi: 去年亏损太严重，只好裁员。
cards.Pinyin: qùnián kuīsǔn tài yánzhòng, zhǐhǎo cáiyuán.
cards.Notes: 亏损 + 裁员 (L26). 只好 = had no choice but to.

cards.English: As soon as layoffs start, everyone gets anxious.
cards.Hanzi: 公司一裁员，大家都很焦虑。
cards.Pinyin: gōngsī yì cáiyuán, dàjiā dōu hěn jiāolǜ.
cards.Notes: 裁员 (L26) + 焦虑 (L15). 一…就/都 = as soon as.

cards.English: When the acquisition news came out, the stock rose twenty percent.
cards.Hanzi: 收购的消息一出来，股票涨了百分之二十。
cards.Pinyin: shōugòu de xiāoxi yì chūlái, gǔpiào zhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī èrshí.
cards.Notes: 收购 + 股票 (L26). 消息 = news, word.

cards.English: You can't burn cash forever; after all, you have to turn a profit eventually.
cards.Hanzi: 不能一直烧钱，毕竟总要盈利。
cards.Pinyin: bù néng yìzhí shāoqián, bìjìng zǒng yào yínglì.
